title: Calibrated, but never checked
title_zh: 校正過，卻從來沒有被核對
lede: Seven checkable habits of measurement discipline, scored by reading 39 decorated 2026 wikis directly. The cohort calibrates well, almost never defines its own error bars, and only twice in 39 teams does anyone measure the same thing twice.
lede_zh: 量測紀律的七項可檢核習慣，直接閱讀 39 支 2026 年獲獎團隊的 wiki 後逐項評分。這群團隊很會做檢量線，卻幾乎不說明自己的誤差棒是什麼；而在 39 支隊伍中，只有兩支真的把同一件東西量了第二次。
body:
We read the wikis of 39 decorated teams — all 14 Best Measurement winners and nominees across the three sections, plus the 30 Top 10 teams, 5 of which overlap — and scored each on seven things a reader can check: a calibration curve into an absolute unit, replicates named by type, an error bar whose meaning is stated, a limit of detection computed for the team's own assay, a negative control or blank, a second instrument or lab measuring the same sample, and a protocol that names the instrument.

**The easy half is done and the hard half is not.** A negative control or blank appears in **38 of 39** wikis (97%) — only Lambert-GA has none. A protocol naming the instrument appears in **35 of 39** (90%). A calibration curve or an absolute-unit anchor appears in **28 of 39** (72%). Then it falls away. Replicates are named by type — biological or technical, not a bare *n* = 3 — in **23 of 39** (59%). An error bar whose meaning is stated in words is in **23 of 39** (59%). A limit of detection computed from the team's own data, with a number on it, is in **6 of 39 (15%)**: WageningenUR, William-and-Mary, UNILausanne, Labi-Taiwan, GCGS and GEMS-Taiwan. And the same sample measured twice, by a second instrument, operator or lab, with the two numbers compared, is in **2 of 39 (5%)**.

**An error bar whose meaning is unstated is itself a finding.** Twenty-three of the 39 wikis print the phrase "error bars"; three of those never say what the bar is. Princeton captions a standard curve "fitted over 0–250 µg/mL with error bars on each standard: y = 0.0013x + 0.2726, R² = 0.9968" — the fit is reported to four decimals and the spread is not reported at all. One sentence does it: McMaster-Canada's BCA figure reads "BSA standard curve from nine blank-corrected standard means, 0–2000 µg/mL, measured in technical triplicate … Error bars show sample SD." Same assay, same chart type, a different reader experience. Six of the 39 never use any dispersion word — SD, SEM, confidence interval, ± — anywhere we could read. One of them is **CalPolySLO, the undergraduate Best Measurement winner**: across nine pages and 124,000 characters, including the most carefully written protocol set in the whole cohort, the characters "±", "error bar" and "standard deviation" appear **zero** times, and its headline PPK2 enzyme curves are labelled "averages of experimental duplicates (n = 2)".

**Nobody checks the instrument.** The word *inter-lab* appears in **0 of the 106 team files** in this report. On the 39 wikis, two teams did it. GEMS-Taiwan ran its inline photometer against a BioDrop benchtop spectrophotometer twice, with TiO₂ and then SiO₂ particle ladders — 45 paired points in August, 40 steps in October, slope 1.018, R² 0.995, residual SD reported for both instruments — and separately compared its leaf and air temperature sensors across **540 paired readings** at three sites, finding a site-dependent offset of −0.2 to +1.8 °C. Athens, an Overgraduate Top 10 team that was never nominated for Measurement, repeated a failed restriction digest with enzymes that had been verified at another laboratory, explicitly "to introduce an independent reference for the digestion step". Honourable third: HongKong-JSS, which names the gap instead of hiding it — "we did not run our samples on a calibrated fluorometer or plate reader alongside the box, so the workflow is unvalidated against a reference instrument" — and, on the same page, explains that "CV = 100 × SD/mean. Lower CV indicates lower relative signal variability, not greater detection accuracy." That is a high-school team teaching what a statistic does *not* mean.

**Does any of it buy you a podium? No.** Scored out of seven, the Best Measurement cohort averages **4.36** and the 25 Top 10 generalists average **3.76** — a gap of six tenths of one checkbox. Split by outcome instead of by award, the effect vanishes and reverses: the 30 Top 10 teams average **3.93**, and the nine decorated teams that did *not* reach a Top 10 — all of them Best Measurement nominees — average **4.11**. The cheap pass over all 106 team files says the same: of 22 teams whose files mention calibration work, 6 made a Top 10 (**27%**); of the 84 that do not, 24 made a Top 10 (**29%**). There is no effect to report. Measurement discipline earns the Measurement prize; it does not move you up the table. The honest version of the dry-lab roadmap's claim is therefore not *uncertainty wins medals* — it is *uncertainty is what makes a number worth keeping after the medals*.

**Where the award itself falls short.** The Best Measurement cohort really does lead on the converting half: calibration **12/14 (86%) against 16/25 (64%)**, and a numeric limit of detection **5/14 (36%) against 1/25 (4%)** — LOD is the single check that cleanly separates the specialists. But on the uncertainty half it does not lead at all. Stating what an error bar means: **8/14 (57%) for the Measurement cohort against 15/25 (60%) for the generalists**. Naming the instrument: **12/14 against 23/25**. WageningenUR, the Overgraduate winner, writes out LOD = 3.3σ/b and LOQ = 10σ/b, builds a separate calibration line per growth medium in µM fluoride, re-zeroes each line on the plate's negative control, and warns that "R² is only descriptive per situation, since it rises with the width of the concentration range" — and then calls its instrument "a microplate reader", with no make, model or wavelength settings. The prize is being awarded for turning a reading into a unit, not for saying how sure you are of it. By section the three tiers are nearly level — Undergraduate 4.07, Overgraduate 3.92, High School 3.92 — and high-school teams actually calibrate most often (10/13, 77%) while naming their replicate type least often (6/13, 46%).
body_zh:
我們直接閱讀了 39 支獲獎團隊的 wiki——三個組別全部 14 支 Best Measurement 得主與入圍隊伍，加上 30 支 Top 10 團隊（其中 5 支重疊）——並就七項讀者可以自行檢核的事情逐一評分：換算到絕對單位的檢量線、依類型指名的重複實驗、有說明含意的誤差棒、針對自家 assay 算出的偵測極限、陰性對照或空白對照、由第二台儀器或第二間實驗室量測同一份樣品，以及一份指名儀器型號的 protocol。

**容易的一半做完了，難的一半沒有。** 陰性對照或空白對照出現在 **39 支中的 38 支**（97%）——只有 Lambert-GA 沒有。指名儀器的 protocol 出現在 **39 支中的 35 支**（90%）。檢量線或絕對單位錨點出現在 **39 支中的 28 支**（72%）。接著就急轉直下。把重複實驗依類型指名——生物重複或技術重複，而不是光寫一個 *n* = 3——的，只有 **39 支中的 23 支**（59%）。以文字說明誤差棒代表什麼的，也只有 **39 支中的 23 支**（59%）。以自己的資料算出、並附上數值的偵測極限，只有 **39 支中的 6 支（15%）**：WageningenUR、William-and-Mary、UNILausanne、Labi-Taiwan、GCGS 與 GEMS-Taiwan。而把同一份樣品用第二台儀器、第二位操作者或第二間實驗室再量一次、並把兩個數字拿來比對的，只有 **39 支中的 2 支（5%）**。

**一根沒有說明含意的誤差棒，本身就是一項發現。** 39 份 wiki 中有 23 份寫出「error bars」這個詞，其中三支從頭到尾沒說那根棒子是什麼。Princeton 的檢量線圖說寫著「fitted over 0–250 µg/mL with error bars on each standard: y = 0.0013x + 0.2726, R² = 0.9968」——擬合報到小數點後四位，離散程度卻完全沒報。其實一句話就夠了：McMaster-Canada 的 BCA 圖說是「BSA standard curve from nine blank-corrected standard means, 0–2000 µg/mL, measured in technical triplicate … Error bars show sample SD.」同樣的 assay、同樣的圖型，讀者的處境卻完全不同。39 支中有 6 支，在我們讀得到的範圍內從未使用任何離散度用語——SD、SEM、信賴區間、±。其中一支是 **CalPolySLO，也就是大學部的 Best Measurement 得主**：九個頁面、124,000 個字元，裡面包含整個 cohort 中寫得最仔細的一整套 protocol，但「±」「error bar」「standard deviation」這些字出現了 **零次**，而它主打的 PPK2 酵素曲線標註為「averages of experimental duplicates (n = 2)」。

**沒有人去核對儀器。** 本報告 106 份團隊檔案中，「inter-lab」這個詞出現了 **0 次**。在 39 份 wiki 上，有兩支做了。GEMS-Taiwan 把自製的管線式光度計拿去和 BioDrop 桌上型分光光度計比對了兩次，分別用 TiO₂ 與 SiO₂ 顆粒濃度梯度——八月 45 組配對點、十月 40 個階段，斜率 1.018、R² 0.995，兩台儀器的殘差標準差都有報出——另外還在三個場址以 **540 組配對讀值** 比較葉片與空氣溫度感測器，量到隨場址而異、介於 −0.2 到 +1.8 °C 的偏移。Athens 是一支從未被提名 Measurement 的研究生組 Top 10 隊伍，他們把失敗的限制酶切重做了一次，改用「已在另一間實驗室驗證過」的酵素，並明說目的是「為酶切這一步引入獨立的參照」。值得一提的第三名是 HongKong-JSS，他們選擇把缺口講出來而不是藏起來——「we did not run our samples on a calibrated fluorometer or plate reader alongside the box, so the workflow is unvalidated against a reference instrument」——而且在同一頁解釋「CV = 100 × SD/mean. Lower CV indicates lower relative signal variability, not greater detection accuracy.」這是一支高中隊伍在教一個統計量「不」代表什麼。

**這些功夫換得到名次嗎？換不到。** 以七分計，Best Measurement cohort 平均 **4.36**，25 支 Top 10 通才團隊平均 **3.76**——差距是零點六個勾選格。改以結果而非獎項來切，效果不但消失還倒轉：30 支 Top 10 團隊平均 **3.93**，而九支獲獎但「沒有」進 Top 10 的隊伍——全部都是 Best Measurement 入圍者——平均 **4.11**。對全部 106 份團隊檔案做的低成本掃描說的是同一件事：檔案中提及校正相關工作的 22 支，有 6 支進 Top 10（**27%**）；沒提的 84 支，有 24 支進 Top 10（**29%**）。這裡沒有效應可報。量測紀律換得到 Measurement 獎，但不會把你往排行榜上推。因此，乾實驗室路線圖那個主張比較誠實的版本不是「不確定度能拿獎」，而是「不確定度決定了獎項散場以後，那個數字還值不值得留著」。

**這個獎項本身不足的地方。** Best Measurement cohort 在「換算」那一半確實領先：檢量線 **12/14（86%）對 16/25（64%）**，有數值的偵測極限 **5/14（36%）對 1/25（4%）**——偵測極限是唯一能乾淨地把專才分出來的一項。但在「不確定度」那一半，它完全沒有領先。說明誤差棒含意：Measurement cohort **8/14（57%）**，通才團隊 **15/25（60%）**。指名儀器：**12/14 對 23/25**。研究生組得主 WageningenUR 把 LOD = 3.3σ/b 與 LOQ = 10σ/b 完整寫出來，為每一種培養基各建一條以 µM fluoride 為單位的檢量線，每條線都用該盤的陰性對照重新歸零，還提醒「R² is only descriptive per situation, since it rises with the width of the concentration range」——然後把自己的儀器稱作「a microplate reader」，沒有廠牌、沒有型號、沒有波長設定。這個獎目前獎勵的是「把讀值變成單位」，而不是「說清楚你對它有多確定」。以組別來看，三個層級幾乎齊平——大學部 4.07、研究生組 3.92、高中組 3.92——而高中隊伍其實是做檢量線最頻繁的一群（10/13，77%），卻也是最少指明重複實驗類型的一群（6/13，46%）。

cards.title: 2 of 39 measured it twice
cards.title_zh: 39 支裡只有 2 支量了第二次
cards.body: Only GEMS-Taiwan and Athens put the same material in front of a second instrument or a second laboratory and compared the two numbers. GEMS-Taiwan has the only quantitative version: 45 paired points of its inline photometer against a BioDrop benchtop spectrophotometer, slope 1.018, R² 0.995, plus 540 paired leaf-versus-air sensor readings at three sites. Everyone else's instrument is trusted because it is the only one they used.
cards.body_zh: 只有 GEMS-Taiwan 與 Athens 把同一份材料送到第二台儀器或第二間實驗室，並把兩個數字拿來比對。GEMS-Taiwan 是唯一有量化結果的：自製管線式光度計對 BioDrop 桌上型分光光度計，45 組配對點、斜率 1.018、R² 0.995，另加三個場址共 540 組葉片對空氣感測器的配對讀值。其他隊伍之所以相信自己的儀器，只是因為那是他們用過的唯一一台。

cards.title: 23 draw error bars, 3 never define them
cards.title_zh: 23 支畫了誤差棒，3 支從未說明
cards.body: GU Frankfurt, Princeton and Stanford all print the phrase "error bars" without ever saying whether the bar is a standard deviation, a standard error or a confidence interval. Six more wikis — CalPolySLO, ETH-Zurich, GHCIS, HongKong-HS, LYON, Stanford — contain no dispersion word at all. The cure is one clause in a caption, and McMaster-Canada shows exactly what it looks like.
cards.body_zh: GU Frankfurt、Princeton 與 Stanford 都寫出了「error bars」，卻始終沒說那根棒子是標準差、平均值標準誤，還是信賴區間。另有六份 wiki——CalPolySLO、ETH-Zurich、GHCIS、HongKong-HS、LYON、Stanford——完全沒有出現任何離散度用語。解法只是圖說裡的一個子句，而 McMaster-Canada 正好示範了它長什麼樣子。

cards.title: 4.36 against 3.76, out of seven
cards.body: The Best Measurement cohort beats the Top 10 generalists by six tenths of one checkbox. It leads clearly on only two of the seven: calibration (86% against 64%) and a numeric limit of detection (36% against 4%). On stating what an error bar means it is level or behind, 57% against 60%. The prize currently rewards converting a reading into a unit, not reporting how sure you are of it.
cards.body_zh: Best Measurement cohort 只比 Top 10 通才團隊高出零點六個勾選格。七項之中，它只在兩項明顯領先：檢量線（86% 對 64%）與有數值的偵測極限（36% 對 4%）。在「說明誤差棒代表什麼」這一項上它持平甚至落後，57% 對 60%。這個獎目前獎勵的是把讀值換成單位，而不是說清楚你對它有多確定。

cards.title: 7 of 7 on the checklist, n = 1 on the headline assay
cards.title_zh: 檢核表 7/7，但主打數據 n = 1
cards.body: GEMS-Taiwan is the only team in the 39 to tick all seven, and it earned that on hardware: a calibration analysis plan committed to the repository before the first measurement, with bias, repeatability, LOD, LOQ and hysteresis thresholds fixed in advance. The wet lab is weaker and the team says so. Its headline secreted ACC deaminase figure, 7.25 mU/mL, is n = 1 and is labelled by the team "below quantitation"; the light-induction error bars are technical wells on a single plate; and for containment it writes that "the detection limit was not recorded and replicate experiments were not performed". Its real contribution is provenance labelling, not replication. The cheapest next step for GEMS is also the most obvious one: run the key assay on three separate days.
cards.body_zh: GEMS-Taiwan 是 39 支中唯一七項全勾的隊伍，而這是靠硬體掙來的：第一次量測之前就把校正分析計畫提交進版本庫，偏差、重複性、LOD、LOQ 與遲滯的門檻全部事先訂死。濕實驗室就弱得多，而團隊自己也這麼說。它主打的分泌型 ACC deaminase 數字 7.25 mU/mL 是 n = 1，團隊自行標註為「below quantitation」；光誘導實驗的誤差棒是單一培養盤上的技術孔；至於菌體滯留，他們寫下「the detection limit was not recorded and replicate experiments were not performed」。它真正的貢獻是來源標註，而不是重複驗證。GEMS 下一步最便宜、也最明顯：把關鍵 assay 在三個不同日期各做一次。

大學部

checklist: Every axis carries a unit a reader outside your lab can interpret. If the unit is RFU, OD or a fold-change, say on the figure that it is instrument-relative and not comparable to anyone else's — Labi-Taiwan does exactly this.
One calibration curve per assay and per medium, plotted and shown rather than described. Give the fit equation, the R², and the concentration range over which it holds.

Say where your samples sit on that curve. If a point falls outside the standards, label the number an extrapolation and state the error you are accepting, the way William-and-Mary reports a ±15% extrapolation.
Name the replicate: "n = 3 biological replicates, separate colonies on separate days" or "n = 3 technical wells on one plate". A bare n = 3 tells a reader nothing.
Every error bar gets a clause in its caption — SD, SEM or 95% CI, and over what. If the figure has no bar because n = 1, write n = 1 on the figure.
Blanks and negative controls appear in the plot, not only in the methods paragraph.

Compute a limit of detection from your own blanks — mean + 3 SD, or 3.3σ/b — and report the limit of quantification beside it. If you cannot, write that the lowest concentration tested is not a validated detection limit, as HongKong-JSS does.

Once per project, measure one sample twice: a second instrument, a second operator, or a second day. Plot the two against each other and report the slope and the residual spread. Two of 39 decorated teams did this; it is the cheapest way to be unusual.
Name the instrument: make, model, wavelength, gain, integration time, path length. "A microplate reader" is not a method, even in an award-winning wiki.
Publish the protocol so a reader can repeat the measurement without emailing you, and record who took each measurement and on what date.
checklist_zh: 每一條座標軸都要有實驗室外的讀者也能解讀的單位。如果單位是 RFU、OD 或倍率變化，就在圖上寫明它是相對於儀器的、無法和別人的數字比較——Labi-Taiwan 正是這麼做的。
每個 assay、每種培養基各一條檢量線，而且要畫出來而不是只用文字描述。附上擬合方程式、R²，以及這條線成立的濃度範圍。
說明你的樣品落在那條線的哪裡。如果有點落在標準品範圍之外，就把那個數字標成外推，並說明你接受了多大的誤差——像 William-and-Mary 報出 ±15% 外推那樣。
把重複實驗講清楚：「n = 3 生物重複，不同菌落、不同日期」或「n = 3 技術孔，同一培養盤」。光寫 n = 3 等於什麼都沒說。
每一根誤差棒都要在圖說裡有一個子句——SD、SEM 或 95% CI，以及是對什麼取的。如果因為 n = 1 而沒有誤差棒，就在圖上寫 n = 1。
空白與陰性對照要出現在圖裡，而不是只出現在方法段落。
用自己的空白對照算出偵測極限——平均值加 3 SD，或 3.3σ/b——並把定量極限一併報出。如果做不到，就寫明所測過的最低濃度並不是經過驗證的偵測極限，就像 HongKong-JSS 那樣。
每個專案至少做一次：把同一份樣品量兩次——第二台儀器、第二位操作者，或第二個日期。把兩組數字互相作圖，報出斜率與殘差離散度。39 支獲獎團隊中只有兩支做了；這是最便宜的與眾不同方式。
指名儀器：廠牌、型號、波長、增益、積分時間、光程。「a microplate reader」不是一個方法，就算寫在得獎的 wiki 上也不是。
把 protocol 公開到讀者不必寫信問你就能重做量測，並記錄每一筆量測是誰做的、哪一天做的。
method: Two passes. Pass one pattern-matched the English dry-lab and science-for-good prose of all 106 team files in research/teams/, which is cheap and covers the whole decorated field but cannot see a practice a team performed and did not write up, nor one the researchers did not record. Pass two read the wikis directly for 39 teams: the 14 Best Measurement winners and nominees (CalPolySLO, McMaster-Canada, Princeton, William-and-Mary, XJTLU-China; WageningenUR, KAUST-KSA, SDU-Denmark, UNILausanne; GEMS-Taiwan, CHINAGuangdongShimen, HangzhouFourteenAP, Labi-Taiwan, Yucai-SZ) and the 30 Top 10 teams, of which Princeton, WageningenUR, KAUST-KSA, GEMS-Taiwan and HangzhouFourteenAP are in both lists, giving 39 distinct teams. Most 2026 wikis are client-rendered, so page text was recovered from the published JavaScript bundles and their lazy-loaded chunks; the static-HTML wikis were fetched page by page over measurement, results, engineering, model, proof-of-concept, experiments, notebook, contribution, description and parts. The two routes are not symmetric: a bundle yields the whole wiki at once, while a static site yields only the pages we asked for, so a static-site team can be undercounted. All headline rates come from pass two. Pass one is reported only where it is stated as such, because against the 39 verified wikis it recovers 39% of the calibration work, 23% of the limit-of-detection work and just 13% of the replicate typing — it is a floor and a ranking, not a measurement. Counting rules: a calibration counts when a standard or calibration curve is described, or when an absolute anchor such as fluorescein, CFU/mL or cells/mL appears at least twice. An error bar counts as defined only when a caption or sentence ties a named statistic (SD, SEM, 95% CI) to the plotted spread. A limit of detection counts only when the team computes one for its own assay and gives a number with a unit; informal uses such as "below the detection limit of the gel" and limits cited from the literature were excluded, which is why the strict count is 6 of 39 while 20 of 39 use the phrase. An inter-instrument check counts only when the same material is measured by a second instrument, operator or laboratory and the two results are compared. The seven-point score gives one point each for calibration, replicate typing, a defined error bar, a numeric limit of detection, a negative control or blank, an inter-instrument check, and a protocol that names the instrument. What this cannot see: a figure. Error bars drawn on a plot whose caption never names them score as undefined, which is the point of the exercise, but a caption baked into an image file is invisible to us, and so is anything in a linked PDF or a supplementary file. Nor can it see work done and not published. All 39 teams are decorated, so none of these rates describes the competition as a whole; they describe the teams that already won something. GEMS-Taiwan is the report author's own team and was scored on the same seven criteria as everyone else.
method_zh: 分兩輪。第一輪對 research/teams/ 中全部 106 份團隊檔案的英文乾實驗室與科學向善敘述做樣式比對；這一輪成本低、涵蓋整個獲獎場域，但看不見團隊做了卻沒寫下來的做法，也看不見研究員沒有記錄的做法。第二輪直接閱讀 39 支團隊的 wiki：14 支 Best Measurement 得主與入圍者（CalPolySLO、McMaster-Canada、Princeton、William-and-Mary、XJTLU-China；WageningenUR、KAUST-KSA、SDU-Denmark、UNILausanne；GEMS-Taiwan、CHINAGuangdongShimen、HangzhouFourteenAP、Labi-Taiwan、Yucai-SZ），以及 30 支 Top 10 團隊，其中 Princeton、WageningenUR、KAUST-KSA、GEMS-Taiwan 與 HangzhouFourteenAP 同時在兩份名單上，合計 39 支相異團隊。2026 年多數 wiki 為前端渲染，因此頁面文字是從已發布的 JavaScript bundle 及其延遲載入 chunk 取得；靜態 HTML 的 wiki 則逐頁抓取 measurement、results、engineering、model、proof-of-concept、experiments、notebook、contribution、description 與 parts。兩條路徑並不對稱：bundle 一次給出整個 wiki，靜態站只給我們指定的頁面，因此靜態站團隊可能被低估。所有主要比率皆來自第二輪。第一輪只在明確標示處引用，因為對照那 39 份已驗證的 wiki，它只找回 39% 的校正工作、23% 的偵測極限工作，以及僅 13% 的重複實驗分類——它是下限與排序，不是量測。計數規則：描述了標準曲線／檢量線，或出現至少兩次 fluorescein、CFU/mL、cells/mL 這類絕對單位錨點，才算有校正。只有當圖說或句子把具名統計量（SD、SEM、95% CI）與圖上的離散度連結起來，誤差棒才算有定義。只有團隊為自家 assay 算出並附上帶單位的數值，偵測極限才算數；像「低於膠體的偵測極限」這類非正式用法，以及引用自文獻的極限，一律排除——這就是為什麼嚴格計數是 39 支中的 6 支，而使用該詞的有 20 支。只有當同一份材料由第二台儀器、第二位操作者或第二間實驗室量測、且兩個結果被拿來比對，才算跨儀器核對。七分制各給一分：校正、重複實驗分類、有定義的誤差棒、有數值的偵測極限、陰性或空白對照、跨儀器核對，以及指名儀器的 protocol。這個方法看不到的東西：圖。圖上畫了誤差棒但圖說從未指名的，計為未定義——這正是本次檢核的重點；但若圖說被燒進圖片檔裡，我們就看不見，連結的 PDF 或補充檔案也一樣。做了卻未發布的工作同樣看不見。這 39 支全都是獲獎團隊，因此以上任何比率都不代表整個競賽，它們描述的是已經贏過東西的那群隊伍。GEMS-Taiwan 是本報告作者自己的團隊，並以與其他人完全相同的七項標準評分。
